question: If the surface area of ​​a sphere is 30,184 cm², find its volume (use π = 22/7).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area = 4πr² = 30,184 cm²

r² = 30184 ÷ (4 × 22/7) = 343 × 7 = 2401 ⇒ r = 49 cm

Volume = (Surface Area × r) ÷ 3 = (30184 × 49) ÷ 3

In terms of options: Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 49 × 49² = (88 × 7 / 3) × 49² = (616/3) × 49²

**∴ The correct answer is 616/3 × (49)² cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Surface area of the sphere = 30,184 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr²

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × r² = 30,184

⇒ (88/7) × r² = 30,184

⇒ r² = (30184 × 7) ÷ 88

⇒ r² = 343 × 7 = 2401

⇒ r = √2401 = 49 cm

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 49 × 49 × 49

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × 22 × 7 × 49 × 49

⇒ Volume = (616/3) × (49)² cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 616/3 × (49)² cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume and Surface Area of Hemisphere

For a hemisphere of radius r, Volume = (2/3)πr³, Curved Surface Area = 2πr², and Total Surface Area = 3πr².

Relationship between Volume and Surface Area of Sphere

The Volume (V) of a sphere can be expressed in terms of its Surface Area (S) as V = (S × r) ÷ 3.

Archimedes Principle for Sphere

The volume of a sphere is two-thirds the volume of its circumscribing cylinder with the same radius and height.</p
